claim: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 third-quarter revenue was $57.0 billion.
summary: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 Q3 revenue was $35.1 billion reported Nov 20, 2024, not $57.0 billion. $57.0 billion is the revenue NVIDIA reported for fiscal 2026 Q3.
